plannen.wat: Billed $204 per year. $20 monthly credits, full Agent, up to 5 collaborators, unlimited published apps.
Up to 10 parallel Agent tasks, up to 15 builders, credits roll over two months.

tools.beperkingen: Core monthly billing price was not shown in the docs we read; the Core figure is the annual price divided by 12.

tools.bestVoor: ChatGPT searches the web for up to date answers with links to sources, inside a normal chat.
tools.gratisWat: Free users can search the web and get up to date information.

plannen.wat: Higher limits and deep research.

tools.privacy: Same as ChatGPT: consumer content may be used for training unless you opt out.

tools.bestVoor: Google Search answers with an AI written response, splits your question into subtopics it searches at the same time, and keeps links to the web. You can ask follow up questions.
tools.gratisWat: Available from google.com, google.com/ai and the Google app.

plannen.wat: Adds Gemini 4 Carbon in AI Mode, with daily limits.

tools.beperkingen: Offered in many countries and languages. Personalization is only for users 18 and over.

tools.bestVoor: Upload your own sources such as PDFs, docs and links, then ask questions, get summaries and listen to Audio Overviews based only on those sources.
tools.gratisWat: Up to 100 notebooks, 50 sources per notebook, basic model access; visible watermark kept.

plannen.wat: Up to 200 notebooks, 100 sources each.
Up to 500 notebooks, 300 sources each, watermark removed.
Up to 500 notebooks, 500 or more sources each.

tools.beperkingen: Daily limits apply and can change.
